figurative_meaning_bn: খুব অল্প পরিমাণে খাবার বা সামগ্রী, যা সামান্য সন্তুষ্টি দেয়
figurative_meaning_en: a very small amount of food or sustenance, just enough to barely satisfy or survive
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একনলা খেয়ে সারাদিন কাজ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He works all day on just a morsel of food.
The poor family gets by on mere scraps.
history: Originates from traditional Bengali eating habits where 'eknola' refers to a single mouthful of rice, symbolizing minimal sustenance in agrarian society.
note: Often associated with 'eknola bhaat' in colloquial usage.
